## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: the instruction tests pass, and the live store shows the three planned verification tasks no longer name the full suite.

## Approach

1. Run `uv run --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_verify_budget.py tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py -q`.
2. Run the `narrow-planned` check command, which reads the three suite acceptances and the three work-items through `adaptive-artifacts`.
3. Do not edit the tree. Do not run the full suite. If either command fails, return fail.
record.subject: verify-verify-budget
